basic_profile.bio: I'm a young entrepreneur based in Austin, Texas, trying to make a mark in the e-commerce world. I have a small online store focused on eco-friendly lifestyle products. Photography is not my strong suit, but I love learning through trial and error. When I'm not working, you can find me binge-watching anime or playing Rainbow Six Siege. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to focus on my business. I usually get online in the evenings after 8 PM, once my day-to-day tasks are wrapped up.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in business administration and have learned most of what I know about e-commerce through online courses and forums. My interest in lifestyle products stems from a personal passion for sustainable living. I'm always looking to improve my marketing skills and often browse Reddit for advice on small business challenges.
